name: ICAR Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) and Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) for Ph.D. (ICAR-SRF (PGS))

value: ICAR All India Competitive Examination for SRF (PGS) / AIEE PhD
rules.quote: ICAR-Junior Research Fellowship/Senior Research Fellowship (JRF/SRF) will be awarded on the basis of merit in the All India Entrance Examination (AIEE) in the Agricultural University.
the candidate must have secured at least 60% marks for General/OBC Category. For SC/ST /Physically Challenged (PC) candidates, the minimum percentage of marks will be 50%.

rules.value: OGPA at least 6.50/10 (5.50 for SC/ST/PC) in Master's
rules.quote: securing Overall Grade Point Average (OGPA) of at least 6.50/10.00 scale, 3.25/5.00 scale, 2.60/4.00 scale for General and OBC Categories and 5.50/10.00, 2.75/5.00, 2.20/4.00 scale for SC/ST /Physically Challenged (PC) candidates
The upper age limit would be 30 years as on the date of the examination for General category.

rules.value: age relaxation 5 years for SC/ST/women/PC/OBC-NCL; 45 for in-service AU candidates
rules.quote: The upper age limit for candidates belonging to SCI ST / Women/PC/aBC (Non-creamy layer as per the Central list of aBC) categories shall be relaxable by 5 years.
The candidates having passed with Bachelor's degree of 3 years' duration are not eligible
300 fellowships are awarded every year based on the merit obtained through All India Entrance Examination (AIEE).

amount.text: Rs 37,000 per month (years 1-2) and Rs 42,000 per month (year 3) w.e.f. 15.10.2024, plus Rs 10,000 per year contingency
amount.quote: Fellowship amount for the first and second year is ₹37,000 per month & for the third year is ₹42,000 per month with effect from October 15,2024. The contingency amount is ₹10,000 per year.
